optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: Product Requirements Analyst, Equipment Maintenance Services
professionalSummary: Analyst with two years on the service‑platform team, responsible for gathering requirements from field technicians and depot staff, writing user stories and acceptance criteria, organising acceptance rounds, coordinating release scope with engineering and field‑service management, and preparing trainer hand‑over documentation.
experienceHighlights: Gathered requirements from field technicians and depot staff through ride‑alongs and depot visits, and wrote user stories and acceptance criteria for the offline checklist and parts‑scan features of the technician app (src_612c3d10e80b).
Organised acceptance rounds for four app releases at the training site with a rotating group of technicians, and kept the results per criterion in a shared sheet (src_ff1b266fb4ce).

Coordinated release scope with the engineering lead and the field‑service manager in the release planning meeting; the engineering lead decided scope and dates, and the field‑service manager approved the rollout order across regions (src_b798f0e05727).
Wrote up each app release for the regional trainers, flagging that parts‑scan only worked on the newer handheld model and listing the steps trainers had to take over (src_8afb40b08d3b).
projectsAndWorkSamples: Parts‑scan story set with acceptance criteria and the results sheet from one acceptance round; ticket numbers are included so entries can be traced (src_39de926268c5).
optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The provided resume and work sample establish the candidate’s experience in requirement gathering, user story creation, acceptance testing, release scope coordination, and trainer hand‑over documentation. They do not establish any documented impact on average on‑site visit time.
